Durant

Bug Steel

Unova · Generation 5

Durant is a Bug/Steel-type Iron Ant Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 33 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Defense (112), with a base stat total of 484.
